en: Illustrated winter night scene of a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance city hall building fronting a snowy square. The façade has a central dome with smaller domes and towers at the corners, many lit windows, and statues around a central monument or fountain. On the left, a row of old townhouses lines a snow-covered street leading to a distant church tower. In the foreground at right stands a woman in traditional dress with a cart of flowers. Decorative cursive German text wishing a happy new year appears in the lower left.
